text.record: Prices rose 13% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 6% for developments with similar features in District 10 — more than similar developments. Based on few sales.

Nanyang Primary School, about 690 m: 1.5 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.

text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are about 18% above similar developments in District 10.
